4g-calling-and-encrypted-64627: 4G calling and encrypted SMS via Signal. That's it. Beautifully made in Switzerland. No apps, no browser, no camera. The thinking person's dumb phone. A statement as much as a tool.
catch-signal-setup-requires-265a6: Catch: Signal setup requires a smartphone initially. Premium price for minimal features.
4g-calls-and-texts-2002b: 4G calls and texts only. Signal Messenger support. Clean OS.
no-social-media-apps-2e674: No social media apps. No browser. No camera.
digital-minimalists-who-need-91b25: Digital minimalists who need a phone but want no smartphone features.
phone-music-maps-podcast-e455f: Phone, music, maps, podcast, notes. Nothing else. Slim e-ink screen. Made by people who believe less is more. Still needs a monthly plan — but radically calmer than a smartphone.
catch-us-focused-initially-9ab2d: Catch: US-focused initially. UK/EU availability limited. Premium price.
4g-e-ink-screen-6e7dd: 4G. E-ink screen. Calls, texts, maps, music, calendar. Nothing else.
no-social-media-no-cf06d: No social media. No browser. No notifications beyond calls/texts.
smartphone-users-who-want-02013: Smartphone users who want to go minimal without losing essential functions.
e-ink-display-calls-7163f: E-ink display, calls, texts, offline maps. Designed by designers who believed phones should do less. The Offline+ mode disables data entirely. Minimal, calm, beautiful.
catch-new-device-from-90362: Catch: New device from small Polish company — long-term support uncertain.
e-ink-screen-4g-e4db0: E-ink screen. 4G calls and texts. Long battery. Minimal design. Hotspot.
no-apps-no-social-303cf: No apps. No social. E-ink reduces screen time compulsion.
those-wanting-the-look-6045c: Those wanting the look and feel of a minimal phone with modern connectivity.
silent-mode-is-written-b5510: Silent Mode is written in one editorial voice, and the voice is the site's. There's no single reviewer behind it, no invented person with a drawer full of gadgets, and nothing here claims anyone lived with these products for a year.
the-idea-is-simple-27d80: The idea is simple. A phone does a lot of jobs at once, and does most of them while trying to keep you there. For plenty of those jobs there's a device that does one job properly: a Kindle for reading, a music player for music, a camera for photos. The catch is knowing they exist.
specs-and-prices-come-97437: Specs and prices come from manufacturers and retailers and change often, so check the product page before you buy. If something here is wrong or out of date, tell us.
one-rule-everything-here-9fb3e: One rule: Everything here does one job. If a device is built to let you check social media or browse the web, it comes off the list.
